A [[Gender/Legends|male]]-patterned '''Human replica droid''' [[Spy/Legends|infiltrated]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During its mission, the replica droid had its face damaged and [[Death/Legends|killed]] a member of the Alliance. The [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] guise possessed light skin and brown hair.
